text: Avenged Sevenfold unveiled a new song titled "Magic" as part of the new Season 01 patch to the video game Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. Key lines: "Living always, always dying," "Smoke in the signals, won't touch the ground," "But you wouldn't listen, or maybe incapable, but that doesn't matter"

meta.note: The song release sits in the post-purge interpretation band, where symbolic material tends to echo field geometry rather than drive it. The lyrical structure maps uncannily well to the past week's events.
